packages.name: fonttools
packages.purpose: TrueType instancing, merging, verification and WOFF2 serialization
packages.network: Only environment setup; subsequent builds require locally supplied pinned source fonts; see TOOL-INPUTS.md

packages.name: brotli
packages.network: Only environment setup; subsequent builds require locally supplied pinned source fonts; see TOOL-INPUTS.md

packages.name: zopfli
packages.network: Only environment setup; subsequent builds require locally supplied pinned source fonts; see TOOL-INPUTS.md

packages.name: pillow
packages.purpose: Bounded alpha-preserving Emoji3D PNG resampling and per-glyph palette compression
packages.network: Environment setup only; production uses pinned local inputs offline

runtime.swift: Apple toolchain, macOS only for native install and preview

fontLicensePolicy: OFL-1.1 font software with retained component grants. Nerd icons retain MIT, CC-BY-4.0, Apache-2.0, OFL-1.1, Unlicense and Bitstream Vera notices. Reserved names and modifications are reviewed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md / RELEASE-RIGHTS.json; inclusion does not grant brand endorsement rights.
toolingLicense: MIT; original FontMod code, scripts, recipes, templates and documentation only; see LICENSE and LICENSE-SCOPE.md. Source and generated fonts retain their component terms.

departureInput.default: departure-build (relative to the FontMod source root)
departureInput.requirements: Verified producer provenance.json, both TTF variants, OFL.txt, NOTICE.md and complete Licenses directory
departureInput.network: No implicit download; prepare this dependency separately.

consumerDelivery.network: No network for existing local inputs.

releaseSourceClosure.acquisition: release-export copies the allowlisted, privacy-adapted source snapshots; source ZIP includes dependencies/
releaseSourceClosure.sourceRebuild: 43 selected source files plus one derived recipe; original/output hashes recorded for changed dependency files; explicit --development; compare four font hashes; no producer Git-release attestation
releaseSourceClosure.network: uv dependencies and pinned upstream Departure font inputs; original Git commits are not required or assumed public
releaseSourceClosure.licenses: Departure OFL/component notices and builder MIT are preserved in each source snapshot
